task_description: store dishes in a dish rack (BotFails domotic_dishTidyUp)

Robot places green plate into dish rack slot (frame 1)
Robot reaches to grasp second green plate remaining on table (frame 2)
Table becomes empty with plates now in rack (frame 3)

Robot lowering green plate into rack slot next to existing plate
Robot gripper contacting second green plate on table; rack now contains at least two plates
Table surface clear of plates; dish rack contains two green plates upright in slots (and third plate visible in rack), robot retracted

uncertainty_notes: Final rack contents partially occluded by rack wires; exact count of plates in rack is slightly ambiguous but at least two upright plates are clearly visible and table is empty
Intermediate transport of second plate not fully shown between frame 2 and 3, inferred from start and end states
assumptions: Plates visible in rack in final frame are the same plates previously on table, not pre-existing duplicates
